items.stem: A thumbnail must above all be:

options.text: Legible and compelling at small size
options.rationale: Correct: thumbnails are viewed small, so clarity wins.

options.text: Packed with as much small text as possible
options.rationale: Small text disappears at thumbnail size.

options.text: Identical to every other video's thumbnail
A plain screenshot with no thought

items.stem: Which TWO describe healthy title-and-thumbnail packaging? (Select TWO.)

options.text: The title and thumbnail complement, not repeat, each other
options.rationale: Correct: together they tell a fuller story.

options.text: The promise is honest and the video delivers it
options.rationale: Correct: honesty protects retention and trust.

options.text: The title overpromises to maximise clicks
options.rationale: Clickbait hurts retention and channel health.

options.text: The thumbnail is unreadable at small size

items.explanation: Correct: together they tell a fuller story.
